scope: Synthetic, zero-learning-rate step timing; no convergence evidence. Step budgets and overhead are planning assumptions.

assumptions.scope: P-frame RGB generator only; 8,800,707 parameters; frozen original latent/entropy/reference path; teacher cached offline
assumptions.primary_case: 256x256 output, batch 2, FP32 parameters with BF16 autocast, L1 plus a frozen untrained VGG16 feature-loss compute surrogate
assumptions.usable_model_budget: 24–72 GPU-hours per substantial attempt, as an engineering allowance rather than demonstrated convergence
assumptions.calendar_budget: 3–7 days for initial fitting, adjustments and independent-video validation after data and implementation are prepared; not a guaranteed completion date
assumptions.main_steps: 300,000–500,000 as an initial planning allowance, not a proven required iteration count
assumptions.overhead: 30–50% extra for unmeasured data loading, augmentation, validation and checkpoints; sustained sample already includes stalls, so this is a conservative allowance, not an observed factor
assumptions.teacher_cache_reference: historical 512x288 actual GLC high-rate encoding core: 0.1704–0.1914 seconds/frame; new latent-cache pipeline not measured
boundaries: No official checkpoint loaded or modified
60-second sample does not establish overnight thermal behavior
No cause attributed to observed long stalls
